working_title: Review customer billing defaults and subscription capacity
purpose: Inspect customer identity/profile/defaults/aging and distinguish these from Resgrid subscription capacity using existing fictional data.

scenes.capture_intent: Open Workforce & Business Operations → Invoicing; read list/status/customer/number filters and any access banner.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Use ordinary module menu
Capture actual filters and actual empty/existing list without edits
limits: No new invoice, subscription, entitlement or payment writes. Empty list is not a paid/settled state.

scenes.capture_intent: Use Billing settings tab and inspect identity/remit fields without change.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Open visible Billing settings tab
Capture safe identity fields; leave registrations blank/unchanged
scenes.result_to_record: Actual displayed values or unsaved-default state.
limits: Do not expose real registration/account data. A GET-created default model is not persisted identity proof.

scenes.capture_intent: Read invoice-footer and pay-link display/expiry settings, with no Save.
required_visible_labels: Show a "Pay online" link on invoices
ordinary_read_only_actions: Normal scroll to footer and link preferences
Capture all discussed controls
limits: Conditional document effects explained from source only; no generated PDF, created pay link, provider or payment claim.

scenes.capture_intent: Only if actual tab exists, inspect unavailable/connection status; otherwise record absence honestly.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Read tab/status only if offered
scenes.result_to_record: Actual availability state; omitted scene if tab absent.
limits: No Connect, disconnect, enable, payment-method Save, provider dashboard or hosted checkout. No secrets/account identifiers captured.

scenes.capture_intent: Use existing Academy Logistics Desk (fictional), Billing tab/profile launcher.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Find exact existing fictional company via Contacts
Open its Billing view and actual profile launcher
limits: Do not recreate/modify Contact. If no profile, capture “No billing profile yet” as an uninitialized state, not saved defaults.

scenes.capture_intent: Read terms/discount/rate card/active/PO preferences without change.
required_visible_labels: Purchase order number required on invoices
ordinary_read_only_actions: Open actual Billing profile
Use normal scrolling/observed anchor to frame Terms below the email input
Do not type, toggle or Save
scenes.result_to_record: Actual form values and saved-vs-new status.
limits: Honor recorder credential-field guard; do not include a painted filled email input or relax the guard. PO flag has no traced enforcement promise. Terms due-date effect occurs at Mark Sent, which is not performed.

scenes.capture_intent: Read billing-address source and tax preference controls.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Normal scroll to actual address/tax controls
Leave all fields unchanged
scenes.result_to_record: Current displayed choices; no tax/registration content entered.
limits: No tax/legal advice or calculated-invoice outcome. Use only existing fictional public addresses; no real identifiers.

scenes.capture_intent: Show rate-card catalog, then Aging through actual tabs.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Read existing rate-card list without New/Edit Save
Use Aging tab
Capture actual bucket/currency/As-of and empty-state if present
scenes.result_to_record: Real rate availability and current aging state.
limits: Do not create rates/debt/payments to populate a report. No outstanding invoices is not proof of completed collections.

scenes.capture_intent: Open department-menu Subscription Plan & Billing separately and read current plan/capacity/add-ons.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Use actual department-menu Subscription entry
Capture actual plan name/count/limits, safe existing tab views only
scenes.result_to_record: Fresh actual capacity evidence; current values authoritative.
limits: No price/recommendation claim from local demo$0 or historical14/Unlimited. No Upgrade/Buy/Cancel/Change billing info/provider or payment-history identity exposure. Current source grants admins, not exclusively managing member.

scenes.capture_intent: Return to customer invoicing and summarize department identity/customer defaults/subscription separation.
ordinary_read_only_actions: Return by ordinary navigation; no Save
scenes.result_to_record: Actual stable view and no billing mutations.
limits: All saved profile/identity, issued-invoice or financial outcomes remain unproven by this read-only plan.

stop_conditions: Missing normal feature/module/permission/add-on access: retain the gate, no enrollment or workaround
Real billing identifiers or filled credential-like inputs painted in frame
No customer profile: teach uninitialized form only, no saved/issued/payment proof
No online tab: omit its controls and record availability boundary
